name: argon-tool-result-appendix
description: Projects eligible host reminders or trailing plain text into the final complete tool result for selected native Argon models.

interface.shortDescription: Choose host-only reminders or trailing plain-text folding into the final complete tool result.
interface.longDescription: On selected native Argon models, tool_result_appendix moves only verified host-generated automatic reminders after a complete tool batch into a tagged text part of the final complete tool result. tool_result_trailing_text folds eligible trailing plain-text user, peer, agent, and skill messages after a complete tool batch into that result. Both strategies leave canonical conversation history, transcript UI, and undo anchors unchanged; media parts remain at their original message boundaries and are not folded.

strategy.title: Projection Strategy
strategy.description: Choose how text after a complete tool batch is sent: passthrough keeps the original message layout; tool_result_appendix moves only verified host-generated automatic reminders into a tagged text part of the final complete tool result; tool_result_trailing_text folds eligible trailing plain-text user, peer, agent, and skill messages into that result. Both strategies leave canonical history, transcript UI, and undo anchors unchanged; media parts remain at their original message boundaries and are not folded.

zh-CN.title: 发送投影策略
zh-CN.description: 选择完整工具批次后的文本如何发送：passthrough 保持原消息布局；tool_result_appendix 只把经验证的宿主自动提醒移入最后一个完整工具结果的标记文本附录；tool_result_trailing_text 把符合条件、紧随完整工具批次的 user、peer、agent 和 skill 纯文本折叠进该结果。两种投影都不改规范会话历史、时间线 UI 或 undo 锚点；媒体片段保留在原消息边界，不会折叠。

targetModels.title: Target Models
targetModels.description: Comma, semicolon, or newline separated model aliases or IDs that opt into request projection.

zh-CN.title: 启用模型列表
zh-CN.description: 使用逗号、分号或换行分隔的目标模型别名或模型 ID（仅明确列出的模型会启用请求投影）。
